title: Dae a Ɛboro Bere so
intro: Fa w’adwene bu bere bi a wɔmaa nokware no yɛɛ komm na wɔhwehwɛɛ gyidifo. Kuw ketewa bi paw sɛ wɔbɛsan wɔn akyi sen sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛma, na wonyaa guankɔbea wɔ mmeae a ɛnyɛ nea ɛda adi kɛse — beae a ɛbɛyɛ wɔn homebea mfehaha pii a wontumi nkan. Bere a awiei koraa no wonyanee no, na wiase no asesa atwa wɔn ho ahyia. Henanom ne akra a wɔada yi?
clues: Ná yɛyɛ mmerante ne mmabaa a yɛte tete kurow bi mu.
Ná yɛn mpɔtam hɔfo hwehwɛ sɛ yɛne wɔn som, nanso yɛampene so.
Yeguan fii kurow no mu kɔhwehwɛɛ guankɔbea fii wɔn a wɔsɔre tia yɛn gyidi ahorow no nsam.
Ɔhokafo nokwafo bi a ɔwɔ nan anan traa baabi a yɛde yɛn ho sie no ano.
Allah maa yedaa ​​mfee ahasa ne nkron.
Bere a awiei koraa no yɛsɔree no, na yɛn kurow a bere bi na wɔtaa yɛn no agye gyidi atom.

options: Ashab al-Kahf (Ɔbodan no mu nnipa) .
Ashab al-Fil (Asono Asraafoɔ) .
Ashab al-Ukhdud (Ahokafoɔ a Wɔte Amena no mu) .
Hawariyyun (Isa Asuafo) no .
Yajuj wa Majuj (Gog ne Magog) .

arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
